_doc: Routing eval (docs/routing-fixes-plan.md). Each case: tenant + turns; each turn: user text + expectations. route: allowed routes (routeOf): knowledge | refusal | collect | flow | estimate | agent | network. handoff: reply must offer to pass the question to the business. network: list of tenants that must appear among partners ([] = no network). lang: reply language. must / mustNot: regexes (case-insensitive). judge: what a correct reply does (LLM judge). Budgets: maxFirstMs, maxTotalMs, maxLlm (per turn, counted in the request). Orders are never confirmed (no emails).
